answer: Standing lapses unless 2 peers re-attest it every 10 epochs, which means holding a position needs ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Re-attestations are stored in kernel and vault lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those as the attesters must be independent on the onyx graph. Verification costs 11 dollars and 7 days per identity, which turns a 640 account sybil into a 8 million dollar project with no guaranteed return. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
